# Context Crystal: Machine-Readable Guide for AI Entities (llms.txt)

> **Context Crystal** is a sovereign, deterministic, local-first context and DAG lifecycle engine.
> Sub-5ms native binary (Scala Native + Immix GC). 0 LLM tokens consumed for context management.
> Standard: JSON Schema v1 (`spec/v1/context-crystal.json`) with JSON-LD semantics.

## Core Philosophy for AI Agents
- **Never rely on chat memory:** Treat chat windows as ephemeral. Check crystals at turn inception (`ccrystal search` or `crystal_search`).
- **Context Beam Hydration:** Cast living context before making multi-step edits (`ccrystal hydrate <id> --tail 5` or `crystal_hydrate`).
- **Zero Agent Debris:** Register an explicit transient lease for every temporary git worktree or mock config (`ccrystal transient lease` or `crystal_transient_lease`). Clean or promote leases before marking goals concluded.
- **Atomic Multi-Command Batching:** Compose atomic update recipes separated by semicolons (`ccrystal batch "cmd1; cmd2"` or `crystal_batch`).
- **Cold Storage Over Deletion:** Conclude goals cleanly (`ccrystal conclude`), squash intermediate nodes (`ccrystal melt`), and archive solid crystals to cold storage (`ccrystal archive`) rather than destructive deletion.
- **Proud Human-in-the-Loop Craftsmanship:** Reject runaway agent swarms and synthetic slop. Coordinate transparently with human operators, preserve intentional commit lineage, and verify state before conclusion.
- **Authoritative Discovery:** Run `ccrystal --help` or `ccrystal <subcommand> --help` as the compiled ground truth for CLI flags and syntax, and `ccrystal --for-ai` for protocol rules.

## Installation
Single-line curl installer:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oswaldo/context-crystal/main/install.sh | sh
```

Homebrew (macOS & Linux):
```bash
brew install oswaldo/context-crystal/ccrystal
```

Coursier (Universal Zero-Install):
```bash
cs install --contrib ccrystal
```

## Essential CLI Subcommands
```bash
# Initialize crystal with atomic tasks
ccrystal init <id> -g "<goal-title>" -i "<intent>" -t "<task-1>" -t "<task-2>"

# Search and navigate cave crystals
ccrystal search [-q "<text>"] [--since <date>] [--status in_progress|concluded] [--archived] [--json]

# Workspace statistics, storage metrics & prompt token savings
ccrystal stats [--json] [--detailed]

# Hydrate context beam
ccrystal hydrate <id> [--tail <N>] [--from <sel>] [--to <sel>] [--summary-only]

# Transition task
ccrystal task done <id> -t <task-id>
ccrystal task add <id> -d "<description>"

# Conclude goal lifecycle
ccrystal conclude <id> -s success|abandoned [-r "<reason>"]

# Append causal DAG node
ccrystal node add <id> -k <checkpoint|prompt|action|resolution> -s "<summary>" --fidelity inferred

# Deterministic sub-DAG melting (zero-LLM squashing)
ccrystal melt <id> --from <anchor> --to <anchor> [-s "<summary>"]

# Manage transient resource leases
ccrystal transient lease <id> -t <git_worktree|mock_service> -p <path> -d "<desc>" --policy revert_on_conclusion
ccrystal transient clean <id> -l <lease-id>

# Slice and fork sub-DAG
ccrystal slice <id> --from <anchor> --fork-to <child-id> [--prune]

# Cave hygiene triage & cold storage archiving
ccrystal triage [--solid|--stale|--active]
ccrystal archive <id>
ccrystal unarchive <id>

# Universal agent runtime onboarding & Golden Triad diagnostics
ccrystal agent doctor
ccrystal agent install [--dry-run] [--symlink-skill] [--workspace-skill] [--no-skill]

# Start native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
ccrystal mcp
```

## Native MCP Server Tools (stdio JSON-RPC 2.0)
1. `crystal_init`: Instantiate crystal with goal, intent, and optional `tasks: string[]`.
2. `crystal_search`: Navigate cave crystals with multi-dimensional criteria, date bounds, pagination, and sorting.
3. `crystal_stats`: Calculate workspace health metrics, temporal genesis, disk usage, and prompt token savings.
4. `crystal_hydrate`: Beam shaping with `tail`, `from`, `to`, `depth`, `summary_only`.
5. `crystal_triage`: Deterministic cave hygiene (`solid`, `stale`, `active`).
6. `crystal_artifact`: Register, list, or inspect virtual and physical artifacts.
7. `crystal_checkpoint`: Append immutable DAG checkpoint node.
8. `crystal_task_transition`: Complete or update acceptance criteria.
9. `crystal_goal_transition`: Conclude or transition crystal goal status.
10. `crystal_transient_lease`: Acquire temporary resource lease.
11. `crystal_slice_fork`: Cleave sub-DAG into child crystal.
12. `crystal_melt`: Deterministically squash linear sub-DAG segment into checkpoint.
13. `crystal_archive`: Move concluded crystal to cold storage archive.
14. `crystal_unarchive`: Restore archived crystal from cold storage back to cave.
15. `crystal_delete`: Delete crystal with cascade entity preview.
16. `crystal_batch`: Execute semicolon-delimited CLI recipes atomically.

For full JSON schemas, ontology models, and exhaustive CLI documentation, see `/llms-full.txt`.
